command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin omega-vps-deploy
git checkout omega-vps-deploy
git reset --hard origin/omega-vps-deploy
BASE=omega_deploy/427cca1300ed597687d720aa94cc1a54cc5abdb5
printf 'CARRIER_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
for f in config/assembly.json omega/__init__.py omega/assembly.py omega/relay_entrypoint.py omega/spool_relay_runtime.py omega/spool_bridge_relay_parallel.py omega/supervisor_outer.py omega/receipt_reconciler.py omega/spool_receipt_reconciler.py; do
  p="$BASE/$f"
  if [ -f "$p" ]; then printf '%s %s\n' "$(git hash-object "$p")" "$f"; else printf 'MISSING %s\n' "$f"; fi
done
